_comment: Copy to ~/.claude/settings.local.json and edit. Claude Code merges this on top of ~/.claude/settings.json (the symlinked common file). Set a plugin to false to disable a common one on this machine; add new ones to enable per-machine extras. The model/effortLevel/alwaysThinkingEnabled/tui/theme keys below are per-machine preferences kept OUT of the synced common file — override each as this machine needs.
_optional_plugins_note: Opt-in personal plugins (NOT enabled lab-wide — absent from config/settings.json, marketplaces not in extraKnownMarketplaces): remotion@remotion, ui-ux-pro-max@ui-ux-pro-max-skill, marketing-skills@marketingskills, claude-mem@claude-mem. Enable by running /sync-claudebase (step 4k detects, asks per plugin, then registers the marketplace + installs at user scope), or manually: `claude plugin marketplace add <ref> && claude plugin install <name> -s user`. If you enable one, list it here (e.g. "remotion@remotion": true) so future syncs don't flag it as reverse drift. claude-mem adds session-start injection — see docs/ai-usage-fitting.md before keeping it.
